styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium tech e-mobility visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, deep charcoal #1C1C1E, deep navy #0B1F5B and one electric blue accent #2E7CE6, with off-white #F2F2F2 text on dark panels and charcoal #2D2D2D text on light panels; neutral-cool studio lighting with front-left soft key, soft contact shadows and a controlled blue glow on tech panels; modern geometric sans-serif short bold headlines; consistent rounded rectangular info cards and thin-line icons; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal tech infographic elements; stable product scale and placement, product never clipped by the frame, clean even margins on every screen; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 从 7 张爆款站立式电动滑板车详情长图切片提炼（第 7 片为二维码水印残片，无信息，已弃用）；已剥离源品牌 LOGO 位、型号编号（HBC-0013）、二维码、会员水印与全部原文案数据；续航/时速/电池容量/功率等数字一律改用 {callout} 文案槽由投放时填入，缺失证据不合成、以图内可核验信息呈现；新增 1 个骑行场景镜（源图无生活方式图）以补全转化漏斗，骑手只保留背影角色且佩戴头盔、不露脸。
